minute-10.english: At every minute from 1 through 15 and from 31 through 45.
minute-10.translation: Ogni minuto da 1 a 15 e da 31 a 45.

minute-11.english: At every 2nd minute from 1 through 30, 40, 41, 42, from 45 through 50, 51 and 52.
minute-11.translation: Ogni 2 minuti da 1 a 30, 40, 41, 42, da 45 a 50, 51 e 52.

hour-1.english: At every minute past hour 1 and 2.

hour-2.english: At every minute past hour 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5.

hour-3.english: At every minute past every hour from 1 through 10.
hour-3.translation: Ogni minuto ogni ora da 1 a 10.

hour-4.english: At every minute past every 2nd hour.

hour-5.english: At every minute past every 3rd hour.

hour-6.english: At every minute past every 4th hour.

hour-7.english: At every minute past every 5th hour.

hour-8.english: At every minute past every 2nd hour from 1 through 10.
hour-8.translation: Ogni minuto ogni 2 ore da 1 a 10.

hour-9.english: At every minute past every hour from 1 through 5 and from 11 through 15.
hour-9.translation: Ogni minuto ogni ora da 1 a 5 e da 11 a 15.

hour-11.english: At every minute past every 2nd hour from 1 through 5, 6, 7, 8, from 10 through 12, 13 and 14.
hour-11.translation: Ogni minuto ogni 2 ore da 1 a 5, 6, 7, 8, da 10 a 12, 13 e 14.

day-of-month-1.english: At every minute on day-of-month 1 and 2.

day-of-month-2.english: At every minute on day-of-month 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5.

day-of-month-3.english: At every minute on every day-of-month from 1 through 10.
day-of-month-3.translation: Ogni minuto ogni giorno del mese tra 1 e 10.

day-of-month-4.english: At every minute on every 2nd day-of-month.
day-of-month-4.translation: Ogni minuto ogni 2 giorni del mese.

day-of-month-5.english: At every minute on every 3rd day-of-month.
day-of-month-5.translation: Ogni minuto ogni 3 giorni del mese.

day-of-month-6.english: At every minute on every 4th day-of-month.
day-of-month-6.translation: Ogni minuto ogni 4 giorni del mese.

day-of-month-7.english: At every minute on every 5th day-of-month.
day-of-month-7.translation: Ogni minuto ogni 5 giorni del mese.

day-of-month-8.english: At every minute on every 2nd day-of-month from 1 through 10.
day-of-month-8.translation: Ogni minuto ogni 2 giorni del mese tra 1 e 10.

day-of-month-9.english: At every minute on every day-of-month from 1 through 5 and from 11 through 15.
day-of-month-9.translation: Ogni minuto ogni giorno del mese tra 1 e 5 e tra 11 e 15.

day-of-month-10.english: At every minute on every 2nd day-of-month from 1 through 10, 11, 12, 13, from 15 through 20, 21 and 22.
day-of-month-10.translation: Ogni minuto ogni 2 giorni del mese tra 1 e 10, 11, 12, 13, tra 15 e 20, 21 e 22.

day-of-month-11.english: At every minute on a weekday nearest to the 1st.
day-of-month-11.translation: Ogni minuto il giorno lavorativo più vicino al 1º.

day-of-month-12.english: At every minute on a weekday nearest to the 15th.
day-of-month-12.translation: Ogni minuto il giorno lavorativo più vicino al 15.

day-of-month-13.english: At every minute on every day-of-month from a weekday nearest to the 1st through a weekday nearest to the 5th.
day-of-month-13.translation: Ogni minuto ogni giorno del mese tra il giorno lavorativo più vicino al 1º e il giorno lavorativo più vicino al 5.

day-of-month-14.english: At every minute on a last day-of-month.
day-of-month-14.translation: Ogni minuto l’ultimo giorno del mese.

day-of-month-15.english: At every minute on every day-of-month from 1 through a last day-of-month.
day-of-month-15.translation: Ogni minuto ogni giorno del mese tra 1 e l’ultimo giorno del mese.

day-of-month-16.english: At every minute on a last weekday.
day-of-month-16.translation: Ogni minuto l’ultimo giorno lavorativo del mese.

day-of-month-17.english: At every minute on every day-of-month from 1 through a last weekday.
day-of-month-17.translation: Ogni minuto ogni giorno del mese tra 1 e l’ultimo giorno lavorativo del mese.

day-of-week-8.english: At every minute on Monday and Tuesday.
day-of-week-8.translation: Ogni minuto il lunedì e il martedì.

day-of-week-9.english: At every minute on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday.
day-of-week-9.translation: Ogni minuto il lunedì, il martedì, il mercoledì, il giovedì e il venerdì.

day-of-week-10.english: At every minute on every day-of-week from Monday through Tuesday.
day-of-week-10.translation: Ogni minuto ogni giorno dal lunedì al martedì.

day-of-week-11.english: At every minute on every day-of-week from Wednesday through Thursday.
day-of-week-11.translation: Ogni minuto ogni giorno dal mercoledì al giovedì.

day-of-week-12.english: At every minute on every day-of-week from Friday through Saturday.
day-of-week-12.translation: Ogni minuto ogni giorno dal venerdì al sabato.

day-of-week-13.english: At every minute on every day-of-week from Sunday through Monday.
day-of-week-13.translation: Ogni minuto ogni giorno dalla domenica al lunedì.

day-of-week-14.english: At every minute on every 2nd day-of-week from Monday through Tuesday.
day-of-week-14.translation: Ogni minuto ogni 2 giorni della settimana dal lunedì al martedì.

day-of-week-15.english: At every minute on every 2nd day-of-week from Wednesday through Thursday.
day-of-week-15.translation: Ogni minuto ogni 2 giorni della settimana dal mercoledì al giovedì.

day-of-week-16.english: At every minute on every 2nd day-of-week from Friday through Saturday.
day-of-week-16.translation: Ogni minuto ogni 2 giorni della settimana dal venerdì al sabato.

day-of-week-17.english: At every minute on every 2nd day-of-week from Sunday through Monday.
day-of-week-17.translation: Ogni minuto ogni 2 giorni della settimana dalla domenica al lunedì.

day-of-week-18.english: At every minute on every 2nd day-of-week.
day-of-week-18.translation: Ogni minuto ogni 2 giorni della settimana.

day-of-week-19.english: At every minute on every 3rd day-of-week.
day-of-week-19.translation: Ogni minuto ogni 3 giorni della settimana.

day-of-week-20.english: At every minute on every 4th day-of-week.
day-of-week-20.translation: Ogni minuto ogni 4 giorni della settimana.

day-of-week-21.english: At every minute on every 5th day-of-week.
day-of-week-21.translation: Ogni minuto ogni 5 giorni della settimana.

day-of-week-22.english: At every minute on every day-of-week from Sunday through Friday.
day-of-week-22.translation: Ogni minuto ogni giorno dalla domenica al venerdì.

day-of-week-23.english: At every minute on every 2nd day-of-week from Sunday through Friday.
day-of-week-23.translation: Ogni minuto ogni 2 giorni della settimana dalla domenica al venerdì.

day-of-week-24.english: At every minute on every day-of-week from Sunday through Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday and from Friday through Saturday.
day-of-week-24.translation: Ogni minuto ogni giorno dalla domenica al martedì, il mercoledì, il giovedì e dal venerdì al sabato.

day-of-week-26.english: At every minute on the last Sunday.

day-of-week-27.english: At every minute on the last Sunday and Thursday.
day-of-week-27.translation: Ogni minuto l’ultima domenica e il giovedì.

day-of-week-28.english: At every minute on Thursday and the last Sunday.
day-of-week-28.translation: Ogni minuto il giovedì e l’ultima domenica.

day-of-week-29.english: At every minute on the last Sunday and the last Thursday.
day-of-week-29.translation: Ogni minuto l’ultima domenica e l’ultimo giovedì.

day-of-week-30.english: At every minute on every day-of-week from the last Sunday through the last Thursday.
day-of-week-30.translation: Ogni minuto ogni giorno dall’ultima domenica all’ultimo giovedì.

day-of-week-31.english: At every minute on every day-of-week from the last Sunday through Thursday.
day-of-week-31.translation: Ogni minuto ogni giorno dall’ultima domenica al giovedì.

day-of-week-32.english: At every minute on 5th Sunday and 3rd Wednesday.
day-of-week-32.translation: Ogni minuto la 5ª domenica e il 3º mercoledì.

day-of-week-33.english: At every minute on every day-of-week from 3rd Wednesday through 5th Sunday.
day-of-week-33.translation: Ogni minuto ogni giorno dal 3º mercoledì alla 5ª domenica.

day-of-week-34.english: At every minute on 5th Sunday and Wednesday.
day-of-week-34.translation: Ogni minuto la 5ª domenica e il mercoledì.

day-of-week-35.english: At every minute on every day-of-week from 5th Sunday through Wednesday.
day-of-week-35.translation: Ogni minuto ogni giorno dalla 5ª domenica al mercoledì.

day-of-week-36.english: At every minute on every day-of-week from Wednesday through 5th Sunday.
day-of-week-36.translation: Ogni minuto ogni giorno dal mercoledì alla 5ª domenica.

month-13.english: At every minute in January and February.
month-13.translation: Ogni minuto a gennaio e a febbraio.

month-14.english: At every minute in January, February, March, April and May.
month-14.translation: Ogni minuto a gennaio, a febbraio, a marzo, ad aprile e a maggio.

month-15.english: At every minute in every month from January through November.
month-15.translation: Ogni minuto ogni mese da gennaio a novembre.

month-16.english: At every minute in every 2nd month.

month-17.english: At every minute in every 3rd month.

month-18.english: At every minute in every 4th month.

month-19.english: At every minute in every 5th month.

month-20.english: At every minute in every 2nd month from January through November.
month-20.translation: Ogni minuto ogni 2 mesi da gennaio a novembre.

month-21.english: At every minute in every month from January through February, March, April and from May through June.
month-21.translation: Ogni minuto ogni mese da gennaio a febbraio, a marzo, ad aprile e da maggio a giugno.

mixed-2.english: At every minute in Europe/Prague time zone.
mixed-2.translation: Ogni minuto nel fuso orario Europe/Prague.

mixed-5.english: At every minute on day-of-month 1 and on Monday.
mixed-5.translation: Ogni minuto il giorno 1 e il lunedì.

mixed-6.english: At every minute on day-of-month 1 and on Monday and Tuesday.
mixed-6.translation: Ogni minuto il giorno 1 e il lunedì e il martedì.

mixed-7.english: At every minute from 0 through 59 past every hour from 0 through 23 on every day-of-month from 1 through 31 and on every day-of-week from Sunday through Saturday in every month from January through December.
mixed-7.translation: Ogni minuto da 0 a 59 ogni ora da 0 a 23 ogni giorno del mese tra 1 e 31 e ogni giorno dalla domenica al sabato ogni mese da gennaio a dicembre.
